mathematical_claim: On nonzero labels, character readouts of powered division have rank one. A bank with frequencies R on the image group of order m has fibers of size gcd(m,R). Exact identification requires gcd(m,R)=1.
diagnostic_rule: Fourier transform the averaged evaluation embedding restricted to reachable nonzero output labels in generator order. Choose the largest divisor g>1 of m for which frequencies divisible by g carry at least 95% of nonconstant energy; otherwise g=1. Report sensitivity at 90%, 99% and 99.9% too.
empirical_prediction: When g>1, heldout prediction^g=target^g accuracy should exceed 95%, and exact nonzero heldout accuracy should be within 10 percentage points of 1/g. This approximate-energy rule is a falsifiable hypothesis, not a theorem.
nonprediction: g=1 does not predict successful learning. The kernel theorem alone predicts neither optimizer trajectories nor a sufficient update budget.
schedule_free_control: The three discovery cases, seed 11, lr in {0.001,0.003,0.01}, betas=(0.9,0.98), weight_decay=1, same 10-step external warmup and 5000-update budget. Evaluate averaged weights, report training-weight metrics separately.
selection: These cases and the 95% threshold were chosen after inspecting seed-11 spectra and confusions. Confirmation labels were not trained when this file was created. This is an internal prospective check, not external preregistration.
